title.narrative: Country Programme for inclusive and sustainable industrial development in Montenegro 2018-2022

description.narrative: The Country Programme (CP) for inclusive and sustainable industrial development (ISID) in Montenegro 2018-2022 constitutes UNIDO#s strategic framework aimed at accelerating ISID in the country through the joint planning and implementation of technical cooperation activities in selected sectors with high growth potential, based on national development priorities as well as UNIDO#s comparative advantage and expertise. It was developed jointly by UNIDO and the Government of Montenegro based on the country#s request and thorough the diagnostic analysis. The CP includes a list of project proposals identified jointly by UNIDO and the Government. These proposals have been tailored with due consideration to the country#s needs and are aligned with the COVID-19 Socio-Economic Response and Recovery Plan. CP Montenegro focuses on the following thematic components: 1) Strengthening industrial competitiveness; 2) Boosting rural development and job creation; 3) Environmental management and sustainable energy. Since the CP is a flexible framework, it allows for new projects and initiatives to be included at any stage in line with the country#s priorities and needs. In 2021, the duration of the CP was officially adjusted from 2017-2021 to 2018-2022.
